findings.evidence: pack_stage stripes bytes uniformly across clusters; weight_service places whole rows on tiles. No shared concrete row/tile/pair placement backs both capacity and bandwidth.
findings.correction: Allocate each row or golden-aligned chunk to tile and its bank streams; charge per-bank words and padding, derive active lanes from this map.

findings.evidence: DAG down has six FP4 routed experts plus one FP8 shared expert; a_proj combines FP8/BF16 and compressors. Generic one-format k/rows calculation cannot price these.
findings.correction: Decompose into actual format/shape subjobs and retain final golden expert accumulation order. FP32 HC must remain dedicated unit, not invented matrix peak.

findings.evidence: evaluate treats any non-null node layer as layer_i including -1; embedding/head may be stored auxiliary stages.
findings.correction: Require explicit node→resident stage mapping and assert every weight node maps to stored tensors.

findings.evidence: layers_per_stage and stage counts change while nonweight DAG hop durations remain untouched.
findings.correction: Replace inherited S81 hops with candidate topology transfer jobs including finite service; preserve old value only as explicitly conservative provisional estimate, not candidate optimum.

findings.evidence: weight_service divides activation bytes by per-tile load port, with no root broadcast bandwidth/fanout contention. Grouped wo_a transfer bytes in DAG are default shape-derived (8192) rather than full 65536-byte attention result.
findings.correction: Describe per-group operands and root/network delivery schedule; do not assume identical operand broadcast for grouped rows/experts.

findings.evidence: max(aggregate_issue, fixed_recurrence) is not an issue-schedule proof for IL8 interleaved feedback; short row batches and K tails may leave bubbles.
findings.correction: Derive group/slot issue count from reused RTL or component latency at full K and tail rows.

findings.evidence: inventory totals mixes scope totals mandatory_ar with kind totals routed_expert including MTP; wo_a checkpoint FP8 needs BF16 expansion or decoder.
findings.correction: Use per-tensor scope or scope_kind_totals; price optional MTP/vision explicitly; expanded mandatory wo_a adds 1340866560 bytes if replacing raw.

findings.evidence: Single conservative bytes-per-pair may be safe but does not prove actual row alignment and scale format support across 274-bit macros.
findings.correction: Track FP4 34B, FP8 33B, BF16 32B payload per physical word, depth and pair stripe assignment; distinguish physical bits from payload.

findings.evidence: compute area input lower bound excludes successor distribution, mux/control, flags/queues/route delta. Routing tracks scalar does not cover all broadcast/return/root cuts.
findings.correction: Retain qualification blocker until full derivative synthesis and contextual floorplan account all macros/wires/clocking.

findings.evidence: Contributor correctly prices NC1 at FP4 256, FP8 128, BF16 64 MAC/cycle as exclusive modes. NC8 are speculative positions sharing weight, not eight AR rows.
findings.correction: Keep these mode peaks exclusive and never multiply by NC for AR.

findings.evidence: Current /tmp/hbrom-dag.json has zero original.stream=true nodes, so whole-node barriers do not currently violate original stream semantics.
findings.correction: Recheck if contributor source changes; Graph.solve duration-only conversion is generally unsafe for stream nodes.
